Will the Sweden Democrats (SD) win the third most seats in the 2026 Swedish parliamentary election?
results.reasoning: Multiple independent polling aggregators (PolitPro, Ipsos, Polara) consistently show Sverigedemokraterna (SD) polling around 19-20%, ahead of Moderaterna at roughly 17.5-18%, giving SD a fairly stable ~1.5-2.5 point lead and translating to seat projections of roughly SD 70 seats vs. M 65-69 seats. This gap has persisted across many polls and pollsters over recent months, making SD landing in second place (not third) the clear base case, mirroring the 2022 election outcome where SD also finished second ahead of M. For SD to fall to third, M would need to close and overtake a multi-point, multi-pollster gap in the final weeks — possible but not the current trend, so I estimate the probability of SD finishing third at around 15%, below the market's 33% crowd price.
results.key_findings: ["PolitPro Election Trend (Aug 28, 2026): S 30.7%, SD 19.2%, M 17.9% — SD projected 70 seats vs M 65 seats","Ipsos poll (May 2026): SD 20% vs M 19%, SD projected 73 seats vs M 69 seats","Polara aggregator (late Aug 2026): SD 19.6% vs M 17.5%, consistent SD lead over M","2022 election precedent: SD finished second nationally ahead of M, matching the current polling pattern","In 2022 SD already outpolled M, so a reversal in 2026 would require a notable swing in the final stretch before the Sep 13 2026 for M to overtake SD"]
